result.title: SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling
result.summary: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. We further develop ProxyStudio, a user interface that integrates text, image references, and interactive 3D proxy editing into agentic modeling workflows. We demonstrate the versatility of SemProxy across object- and scene-level modeling tasks with different coding agents, and evaluate its effectiveness in supporting controllable human-agent collaborative 3D modeling through a user study.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SemProxy，一种以带标签 3D 包围盒实例化的轻量中间表示，可序列化为结构化文本或渲染成图像，供现有 coding agent 在 3D 建模中直接使用，并配套 ProxyStudio 交互界面，通过用户研究评估人机协同建模的可控性。
